info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/nano-banana-pro/edit queue.

x-fal-metadata.about:
Gemini 3 Pro Image is a text-to-image model that generates images from text descriptions.

Decompression-bomb inputs to ``image_urls`` are rejected upstream by
``validate_image_async`` (called from ``GoogleAIClient._format_image``):
the validator now enforces a header-only ``max_image_pixels`` cap
(default 89,478,485 ≈ PIL's ``MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS``) *before* any pixel
decode, so oversized inputs raise a deterministic 422
``image_too_large`` instead of OOM-killing the runner and taking out
every multiplexed request on it (``max_multiplexing=20``).

top_p.title: Top P
top_p.description: Nucleus sampling probability. Omit to use the provider default of 0.95. Explicit values use a direct Google or Vertex API.

thinking_level.title: Thinking Level
thinking_level.description: Thinking effort. Pro Image supports only high; omit to retain its provider default. An explicit level requests summaries unless include_thoughts overrides it. Thinking cannot be disabled.

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

image_urls.title: Image URLs
image_urls.description: The URLs of the images to use for image-to-image generation or image editing.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Omit to use the provider default of 1. Explicit values use a direct Google or Vertex API.

num_images.title: Number of Images
num_images.description: The number of images to generate.

history.title: History
history.description: Previous native user/model turns. Replay a returned conversation's messages unchanged, including thought signatures; the current prompt is appended as a new user turn.

system_prompt.title: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: Optional system instruction that steers the model's persona and output style across the request. Leave blank to omit; when provided, it is sent as the system instruction to Gemini (or as a system message on OpenAI-compatible providers).

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: The resolution of the image to generate.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: The format of the generated image.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The seed for the random number generator.

return_history.title: Return History
return_history.description: Return reusable native conversations with original image parts and provider thought signatures. Uses a native provider. Each generated conversation is independent; send its messages as history for the next turn.

limit_generations.title: Limit Generations
limit_generations.description: Experimental parameter to limit the number of generations from each round of prompting to 1. Set to `True` to to disregard any instructions in the prompt regarding the number of images to generate.

prompt.title: Prompt
examples: make a photo of the man driving the car down the california coastline

max_output_tokens.title: Max Output Tokens
max_output_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens for the generation. Omit to retain the provider default. Explicit values use a direct Google or Vertex API.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated image, including 1:4, 4:1, 1:8 and 8:1.

enable_web_search.title: Enable Web Search
enable_web_search.description: Enable web search for the image generation task. This will allow the model to use the latest information from the web to generate the image.

context.title: Context
context.description: Ordered text, original images, PDF or UTF-8 text documents appended to the current prompt. Uses a native provider. Images count toward the total 14-reference limit.

safety_tolerance.title: Safety Tolerance
safety_tolerance.description: The safety tolerance level for content moderation. 1 is the most strict (blocks most content), 6 is the least strict.

include_thoughts.title: Include Thoughts
include_thoughts.description: Whether to include thought summaries. Omit to preserve the existing behavior: an explicit thinking_level requests summaries. Set limit_generations=false to return summary text in description. This does not disable thinking or return intermediate thought images.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.description: Reusable per-generation conversations, populated only when return_history is true. Retain every part and thought signature when continuing a conversation.

description.title: Description
description.description: The description of the generated images.

grounding_metadata.title: Grounding Metadata
grounding_metadata.description: Provider grounding metadata for the generated images, including search queries, source pages and image-source attribution when available.

parts.title: Parts
parts.description: Ordered text, image, document, and signature parts.

thought.title: Thought
thought.description: Provider thought marker, preserved when replaying a returned conversation.

text.title: Text
text.description: Text at this position in the conversation.

thought_signature.title: Thought Signature
thought_signature.description: Opaque provider-issued thought signature. Replay it unchanged on its original part.

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: Original image URL or data URI. Replayed without resizing or re-encoding.

file_url.description: PDF or UTF-8 plain-text document URL or data URI (up to 15 MB).
